blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The International Criminal Court (ICC) has allowed the prosecution to admit as evidence the testimony of a witness who is said to have proof on the operations of the Davao Death Squad (DDS). This scheme was allegedly the brainchild of former President Rodrigo Duterte, according to the prosecution. In its Oct. 2 decision, the Trial Chamber III of the ICC granted the prosecution’s request to introduce as evidence the written statement of witness identified as ‘P-1100.’ The chamber said that it was satisfied that the substance of his pieces of evidence “appear relevant to the background of and context of […]...
